item: A custody export's signed head commits to every entry hash (bundle format 2; R714)
key_paths: src/custody/log.py; scripts/verify_custody.py; src/api/custody.py; docs/SECURITY.md; docs/USER_MANUAL.md; tests/test_custody_bundle_format.py
summary: R714. The signed head committed only to a bundle's count and last entry, so in a one-item bundle (whose entries are not linked) a middle entry could be swapped for another signed by the same key, e.g. from a log copied onto a second machine. Exports are now written only in bundle format 2, whose head carries bundle_format and a digest of every entry's seq and hash; the checker refuses a swap, an addition or a removal by name, refuses an unknown format, and cannot be downgraded (the format is in the signed head). A format-1 bundle still verifies, but the CLI, the route and the report say it is the weaker format and what it does not prove (format, format_note; the CLI exits 3, not 0), never as equal. Existing bundles are never re-signed.
